beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip one: use a password manager.
beats.title: 1. Password manager

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: A strong, different password for every account. It remembers them all.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Exactly. Tip two: long beats complicated.
beats.title: 2. Long beats complicated

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Four random words beat 'P@ssw0rd!' every time.
beats.tts: Four random words beat P at S S W zero R D. Every time.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip three: turn on two-factor login.
beats.title: 3. Turn on 2FA

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Even if someone steals your password, they still can't get in.
